capabilities: Render calendars from itinerary-event blocks in notes
Insert and edit events through a form with time zone and tag fields
Filter displayed events with filtrex expressions
Apply vault-wide event rules that set options like color and order
Pass FullCalendar options such as views, date ranges, and header toolbar
extras: The README includes a version 1 to version 2 upgrade guide (FullCalendar 5 to 7) and notes the plugin requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer.
problem: Trip or event plans written as plain text make it easy to miss conflicting events or forget bookings, and Obsidian has no way to display a set of note events on a calendar.

relations.evidence: This is all built upon the excellent FullCalendar javascript library.

summary: Renders monthly, weekly, daily, and list calendars in notes from itinerary-event blocks, with time zone support, filtering, and a form for inserting events.
